name: rhdh-pr-create
description: Publishes verified changes from rhdh-plugins or community-plugins: detect the repository and affected workspaces, run the repository build pipeline, create package changesets, stage generated files safely, create a signed-off commit and branch, push, open a GitHub pull request, upload optional bug-fix recordings, and link Jira or GitHub issues. Use for raise PR, create or open a plugin PR, push verified plugin changes, or publish a verified change another skill handed off.
